title: docsrs-cli agent_surface reduction report
description: Object attached at envelope top level (sibling of data, never inside it) when any agent-native reduction knob is active: --select/--fields, --filter, --sort-by, --dedupe-by, --max-items, --count-only or --truncate-content. --max-output-bytes alone does not attach it. An envelope with ok=false is passed through untouched and never carries this object. Application order is fixed: filter, sort-by, dedupe-by, max-items, select, count-only, truncate-content, max-output-bytes.

input_count.description: Elements in the located result array before reduction. Reports 1 when the payload carries no array and projection applied to the data object itself.

output_count.description: Elements emitted after the whole pipeline, including any drop forced by --max-output-bytes. This is the authoritative post-reduction count.

limited.description: True when --max-items discarded at least one element. Distinguishes a genuinely small result from a truncated one: without it a caller cannot tell whether raising the cap would return more.

content_truncated.description: True when --truncate-content shortened at least one string. Truncation counts characters, never bytes, so a multi-byte sequence is never split.

output_truncated.description: True when --max-output-bytes dropped trailing elements to fit the budget. Whole elements are removed; the JSON text is never sliced, because an unparseable document is worse than an over-budget one.
